project.description:
🔑 SSL/TLS CSR Generator

Generates a secure Certificate Signing Request (CSR) and accompanying private key for SSL/TLS certificate provisioning.

org.biouno.unochoice.ChoiceParameter.name: commonName
org.biouno.unochoice.ChoiceParameter.description: Select the Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) to secure. (Auto-populated from metadata registry)

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: countryName
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Two-letter ISO country code (e.g. FR, US, IN).

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: stateOrProvinceName
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Full name of the state or province.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: localityName
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Full name of the city or locality.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: organizationName
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Legal name of your company or organization.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: emailAddress
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Contact email address for administrative notifications.

hudson.model.TextParameterDefinition.name: subjectAltName
hudson.model.TextParameterDefinition.description: Subject Alternative Names (SAN). Enter one domain name per line to secure multiple domains under the same certificate.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command: ansible-playbook -u "$ANSIBLE_USER" --private-key "$ANSIBLE_PVT_KEY" --extra-vars "commonName=${commonName} countryName=${countryName} localityName=${localityName} stateOrProvinceName=${stateOrProvinceName} organizationName=${organizationName} organizationalUnitName=${organizationalUnitName} emailAddress=${emailAddress} subjectAltName=${subjectAltName}" /etc/ansible/playbooks/generate_csr.yml cat /site-data/csr-certs/${commonName}/${commonName}_$(date '+%Y-%m-%d').csr ls -ltr /site-data/csr-certs/${commonName}/
